note: City of Spillville park campground beside the Turkey River, with a canoe landing, disc golf and ball field. --Claude
summary: City and PitchCamp pages: 22 lots, 13 with their own 30/50 amp; online booking and $5 fee added; ordinary rate still not posted; riverfront lead to creekside.
flags: WATERFRONT LEAD (riverfront -> creekside, unsure so going down; I changed nothing): pads at the north end sit about 10 m from the water over an open rip-rap bank and grass, no road between, so the on-water part stands. Channel width is the question: 18-25 m of water at the sites in leaf-off and summer imagery, about 33 m bank to bank counting gravel bars. That straddles the 30 m line. It's the Turkey River by name, and a camper review reads 'Large sites near river'. Not every pad qualifies: sites along the road further east are farther back.

RATE NOT POSTED: neither page gives an ordinary night. RV Life reviews, for what they are: $20 a night (stayed 7/2026, fifth wheel, site 2) and $25 (stayed 7/2024, motorhome, site 9). Not written: the operator has a web page, so the camper-report allowance doesn't apply. PitchCamp would price a dated search, but I didn't run one. City Hall could confirm.

WATER AT SITES: the same 7/2026 review says 'No sewer or water at sites, but the is a potable water source'. The 7/2024 review also logs water no, sewer no. Operator is silent, so hookups stay electric only, with water and sewer unset.
PHONE (apply.py doesn't write it): PitchCamp lists campground contact 563-380-0148; stored 563-562-3425 isn't on either page I read.
SEASON: not stated by the city or PitchCamp; left unset.

PIN: stored 43.1972,-91.9462 is in trees at the river confluence, about 170 m from the north pads and 65 m from the southern ones. Site centre is about 43.1982,-91.9463 (imagery; about 110 m). Under the line for moving it, though the point itself is not on a site.
